CustomField.description: Compares the Asset Rank to the "best" Asset Scores on the Account Group Member to control if the current record is rendered on the dynamic related list of Asset Terminations on the Account Group page
CustomField.formula: OR( ( ROUND( Asset__r.Rank__c , 0 ) == ROUND( Account_Group_Member__r.Best_WO_Asset_Rank__c , 0 ) ) , ( ROUND( Asset__r.Rank__c , 0 ) == ROUND( Account_Group_Member__r.Best_WXWA_Asset_Rank__c , 0 ) ) )
CustomField.label: Is Relevant Asset
